# Asset Side

> Asset Side is the independent marketing consultancy of Archit Aggarwal, a growth and PR partner for luxury, couture, and D2C brands. The practice combines performance marketing, brand positioning, PR, events, and retail placement into one senior-led engagement, working with a strictly limited client roster. Clients include labels across fashion, jewellery, western wear, menswear, and NGO fundraising, with placements on Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, Tata CLiQ Luxury, Ensemble, and Aashni+Co.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://assetside.lovable.app/): Overview of the practice, philosophy, and services
- [Work](https://assetside.lovable.app/work): Selected engagements and outcomes
- [Case Studies](https://assetside.lovable.app/case-studies): Eleven detailed client case studies with objectives, strategies, and measured results
- [Insights](https://assetside.lovable.app/insights): Long-form essays on luxury marketing, PR, and growth philosophy
- [Privacy Policy](https://assetside.lovable.app/privacy-policy)

## Services

- [Performance Marketing](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/performance-marketing): Full-funnel Google and Meta paid media built around CAC and ROAS
- [Brand Positioning & GTM Strategy](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/brand-positioning-gtm): Audits, positioning, and go-to-market plans for luxury and D2C labels
- [D2C & WhatsApp-First Commerce](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/d2c-whatsapp-commerce): Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns and conversation-led selling flows
- [Growth & Lead Generation Systems](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/growth-lead-generation): Multi-channel lead generation, CRM setup, and marketing automation
- [SEO & Website Optimization](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/seo-website-optimization): Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and local SEO for multi-outlet businesses
- [Marketing Analytics & Reporting](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/marketing-analytics): GA4, Looker Studio and Power BI dashboards, recurring reporting
- [PR](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/pr): Editorial placements, celebrity styling, and founder features run alongside paid campaigns
- [Events](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/events): Exhibition and event management, ticketing, check-in, and post-event retargeting
- [MBO Placements](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/mbo-placements): Multi-brand outlet placement across Indian and international luxury retailers
- [Social Media Marketing](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/social-media-marketing): Content calendars, production, and community management
- [Campaign & Brand Shoots](https://assetside.lovable.app/services/campaign-brand-shoots): Creative direction and full production management for campaign imagery
